run_kilt_trex_preprocessing: run the Kilt_TREX main function to generate k-shot data for multiple random seeds
create_kilt_trex_dataset: create a Kilt_TREX dataset instance to load and preprocess the TREX knowledge base dataset
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a HuggingFace TREX dataset split to a list of input-answer tuples with newlines replaced
load_kilt_trex_dataset: load the kilt_tasks TREX dataset from HuggingFace datasets using the load_dataset method
generate_k_shot_data: generate k-shot train dev and test splits from the Kilt_TREX dataset with a given seed
